revision.description: The membership revision the caller last saw; the join fails with MembershipChanged if it moved.

errors.name: InvalidInvite
errors.description: No valid invite for this account: missing, expired, spent, disabled, or bound to another account.

errors.name: MembershipDisabled
errors.description: This AppView does not admit accounts by membership.

main.description: Join the town, or rejoin after withdrawing. An account hosted on the town's own PDS needs no code; any other account presents an invite code: either a town invite or a code a member took from Settings on the town's PDS, which the join then spends. Requires auth.
